title: Keep the attention completion journey within its timeout under load

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage — Caught

**Story and revision.** `SEED-341#keep-attention-completion-journey-within-timeout` at `bdf484822c970f05d8450d5acc580768c19e6cf1`. The selected promise is that Mark as read clears the card control and records the receipt of the retained unfinished report.

**Fault and reach.** In an isolated scratch checkout, the only fault replaced the assigned `reportRead` in `dashboard/server/launchRecordStore.ts:178` with a different, valid UUID. The maintained fixture exercised a Taken Codex session with an absent workspace and a retained unfinished report. The browser trace captured the Mark as read click's `POST /__agent-launch/read` returning 200. A separate read-only observer captured the written store for that same native thread, with completion receipt `11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111` and the wrong persisted mark `24601680-0c45-4c19-994a-43eac38672e2`. The report still carried its unfinished outcome and had no Done mark.

**Maintained proof.** The normal Playwright command `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/sessions/agent-completion-attention.spec.ts --workers=1 --grep 'Read leaves the session open for Done$'`, under the AC sleep guard, selected exactly one case on all three runs. Baseline passed. With the fault, the assertion `expect(markRead).toHaveCount(0)` at line 223 received one button after the click. This assertion caught the visible consequence before the later direct store assertion ran. The original file was restored byte-for-byte, Git status matched the clean pre-probe state, and the same case passed again. The scratch worktree was then removed.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing assertion for this Read regression. The result requires no new proof or follow-up for this path.

- **Test runtime.** 22.49 s measured across the three selected runs in Playwright's terminal proof records, comprising 7.09 s baseline, 9.92 s faulted, and 5.49 s restored. An initial anchored selector matched no cases and took 3.28 s. Correcting the selector preceded the passing baseline.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because no separate effort measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because no separate effort measurement was recorded.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 163813 ms (measured), from 1795418512441 to 1795418676254 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — `bdf484822c970f05d8450d5acc580768c19e6cf1`, Caught, no follow-up.
